name: plan_top_down_parallel_grasp
summary: Generate profile-aware, TCP-compensated, IK-checked top-down parallel-jaw grasp stages from explicit object geometry.

generality.rationale: The planner is independent of object category and perception method and consumes only a bounding footprint, but is restricted to top-down parallel-jaw grasps on horizontally supported rigid objects.
assumptions: The object center and footprint geometry are expressed in the world frame.
A top-down parallel-jaw grasp through the geometric center is appropriate.
The arm provides IK and the gripper profile declares its geometry and TCP.
limitations: Does not plan side grasps, suction grasps, contact-rich grasps, or non-rigid manipulation.
Checks discrete IK waypoints but not continuous-path collision or dynamics.
Does not score grasp stability from a mesh or material model.

level.rationale: It combines profile contracts, coordinate transforms, TCP compensation, aperture feasibility, deterministic candidate generation, and chained IK.

composition.strategy: Map generic footprint geometry and standardized gripper axes into candidate world poses, then retain a profile-compatible chained-IK plan.

provenance.failure_gap: After successful localization, Qwen guessed joints instead of constructing TCP-correct grasp poses and validating reachability.
evidence: iter_001 contains fourteen guessed servo calls without a verified grasp
